fn: Log Details: 'Shift active' is now shown only for the hole the shift was actually started on. Picking a different hole (for example after an import) shows 'Shift not started' and the Start shift button, instead of inheriting the other hole's running shift.
Viber text: downhole survey results imported from Excel no longer fill the Viber automatically. They show only while a shift is started for that hole (or if you switch the shot on yourself).
ds: Hole header: 'Shift active' now applies only to the hole the shift was started on.
